body.name: Bzero
body.def: A completion \(b\) chooses every incident branch of the minimum, positive-part, capacity, generalized-inverse, and separate same-law endpoint programs. It must agree with every nonzero base sign \(\psi(p_0)\), may choose every incident side of a fixed tie, and assigns each active cut \(\psi(p_0)=0\), \(B^{\prime}\alpha_{\psi}\ne0\), by the weak tangent inequality \(\alpha_{\psi}^{\prime}Bu\ge0\) or \(\le0\). Only primal-dual feasible optimal symbolic completions are retained, and equalities belong to every incident completion.
body.role: all legal completions of the global tangent arrangement
